summary: Give a fictional remote station a readable purpose through zones for arrival, work, habitation and maintenance.
objective: A viewer can distinguish habitation from machinery and can trace the route between the landing area and the entrance.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a science-fiction outpost
Use sci-fi base as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Design a sci-fi mountain outpost with connected living modules and an inspectable docking mechanism.

principles: Give a fictional remote station a readable purpose through zones for arrival, work, habitation and maintenance.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Repeat an authored module interface but vary silhouettes by function; expose selected ducts, docking parts or access panels.
Separate structural shells, service markings and small status accents; use a clear exterior key plus interior light where people would look.
Use an arrival view followed by selectable zones; doors and equipment act from explicit fictional state rather than random pulses.
observable_checks: A viewer can distinguish habitation from machinery and can trace the route between the landing area and the entrance.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with low-poly, photorealistic ambition or holographic overlays; invented technology is not evidence of feasible engineering.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
